protocol.purpose: Retrospective comparative review after PCS audit; not untouched out-of-sample validation
protocol.selection: Choose one common model by highest minimum BTC/ETH Calmar on 2020-2022; do not reselect on later periods or per asset

models.definition: Frozen PCS A or B; SL1.5 ATR; TP1 50%; BE; trail2.5 after TP1
Only original door A; original PCS exits
Original A or B, no TP1, trail2.5 ATR from entry; distinct research variant
Previous squeeze ON, current OFF, close>EMA20; SL1.4 ATR; trail2.2 ATR from entry. Explicit audit interpretation, not full Carter UI engine
Original B plus original regime; SL1.5 ATR; trail2.5 ATR from entry, no TP1
Original regime and close>prior highest high21; SL1.5 ATR, trail2.5 ATR from entry, no TP1
EMA50 crosses above EMA200; exit on reverse cross at next open; SL3 ATR, no TP, no time or trail

limitations: Prior aggregate OOS results have already been seen
No historical top-50 membership or survivor-free portfolio backtest
No rule changes or repeated tuning after viewing the result
Real future performance cannot be established by reusing past data
